import sys
sys.path.append('storage/shared')
from meta.anomaly_experiments.sentinel import sentinel_write

sentinel_path = 'storage/shared/meta/sas/plasticity/zephyr_sentinel_r2.txt'
content = 'R2_RECOVERY'  # Simple payload

result = sentinel_write(sentinel_path, len(content), content)
print(f"R2' sentinel result: {result}")
